title: Here's why you shouldn't use LinkedIn's default headline
description:
By default, your LinkedIn headline shows up as your current title and company, but you can use the 220-character limit to your advantage and make sure you're strategically using keywords that apply to the job you’re seeking so that you show up in more relevant search results. 

Your headline is also a great opportunity to highlight your wins or the value that you bring to the table.
